name: Dust2.us
description: A Counter-Strike-focused outlet, portrayed in the Kairos Universe filming a ten-player roster feature with the Kairos CS Main and Academy rosters.
coverageDisclosure: Dust2.us is a real-world Counter-Strike news outlet. Every article credited to Dust2.us on Kairospedia is a fictional dramatization written for the Kairos Universe story. None of it represents an actual Dust2.us publication, video, or statement.
notes: Used once in-universe for the Episode 98 roster feature filmed at the Kairos campus; Dust2.us has no other editorial role in the Kairos Universe continuity.
The episode never confirms a real-world Dust2.us release date for the footage; Kairospedia's archive entry records only when Kairospedia itself compiled the public page, not an outlet broadcast date.
